## Regenerate

```powershell

$env:DATABASE_URL="postgresql://postgres:<PASSWORD>@switchback.proxy.rlwy.net:17304/railway"
python scripts/root-oneoffs/generate_db_state.py
```

Tip: for a deeper (non-canonical) inspection report, run:

```powershell
$env:DATABASE_URL="postgresql://postgres:<PASSWORD>@switchback.proxy.rlwy.net:17304/railway"
python scripts/root-oneoffs/inspect_current_data_v3.py
```
